input.summary: Re-base the mutual cap on 12 months' amounts paid or payable under the Agreement, with a USD 1,000,000 floor, instead of the USD 12,000 implementation fee under the first Order Form.
input.comment: [Playbook] As drafted the cap is measured by "Fees", which is defined as the one-time USD 12,000 Implementation Fee under the first Order Form, so the mutual cap is illusory; our position is the greater of twelve months' amounts paid or payable and USD 1,000,000. Excluded Claims (including indemnification, confidentiality, data-protection and security breaches) remain outside the cap, and Customer's payment obligations remain unaffected.

ops.oldText: shall not exceed the Fees paid or payable by Customer under the first Order Form during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim
ops.newText: shall not exceed the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000
